labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Participants must have had documented progression during or within 12 weeks after the last dose of PD-1 checkpoint inhibition-based therapy.

Participants must have histologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck (HNSCC) that is either locally recurrent and non-amendable to curative therapy (e.g., radiation, surgery) or metastatic.
Participants must be able to take oral medication without breaking, opening, crushing, dissolving or chewing capsules

labels.note: Post-PD-1 metastatic HNSCC fits; she is fed by tube for radiation dysphagia, so whether she can swallow cabozantinib whole is not stated.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Disease progression after having received treatment with ≥1 and <3 prior lines of systemic therapy in the unresectable recurrent or metastatic setting.
Must have had disease progression on anti-PD-(L)1 (either as monotherapy or in combination with chemotherapy or other therapies).
Has Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0 or 1 at screening.

labels.note: HER3-DXd HNSCC cohort: oral cavity SCC progressing after one R/M line of pembrolizumab + platinum; measurable, ECOG 0-1.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients with recurrent disease or multiple primaries are ineligible
Patient has undergone total resection of the primary tumor with curative intent

labels.note: Post-operative RT trial for newly resected disease; she has metastatic recurrence after surgery and chemoradiation in 2023.

labels.label: not_relevant

evidence.quote: Have a histologically confirmed diagnosis of a locally advanced recurrent or metastatic solid tumor type of interest with MTAP deletion

labels.note: Tumor types are mesothelioma, gastroesophageal, pancreatic, biliary, NSCLC and urothelial; head and neck SCC is not listed.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Patients with prior therapy with an anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1

labels.note: AIM-NIVO; she has had pembrolizumab (and has no autoimmune disease).

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Previously untreated for recurrent and/or metastatic disease incurable by local therapies.
Patients should not have received any prior treatment in the recurrent or metastatic setting.

labels.note: First-line platinum-refractory R/M trial; she has already had pembrolizumab-chemo for her recurrence.
